**  

Dear [Authorized OEM Partner],

The Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (PGCIL) invites your esteemed organization to submit a formal quotation for the supply of control panels as outlined in the tender reference **GEM/2026/B/TEST_BROKEN**. This RFQ forms part of the **Procurement of Control Panels** project and is issued under the authority of **PGCIL**.

---

### 1. Scope of Work  
Supply, test, and deliver the control panels in accordance with the technical specifications and delivery requirements detailed below.

### 2. Itemized Bill of Quantities (BoQ)

| # | Item Description | Quantity | Unit | Technical Specification | Delivery Location | Required By Date |
|---|------------------|----------|------|--------------------------|-------------------|------------------|
| 1 | **[NEEDS REVIEW: item_name]** | **[NEEDS REVIEW: quantity]** | Nos | **[NEEDS REVIEW: technical_spec]** | **[NEEDS REVIEW: delivery_location]** | – (to be confirmed) |

*All items are subject to the technical compliance sheet attached to this RFQ.*

### 3. Commercial Information Required  
For each line item, please provide the following details:

1. **Unit Price** (exclusive of GST) – in INR.  
2. **Lead Time** – expressed in weeks or days from receipt of purchase order.  
3. **GST Breakdown** – applicable GST rate, amount, and total cost inclusive of GST.  
4. **Technical Compliance Sheet** – confirmation that the supplied equipment meets the stated technical specifications, including any relevant certifications or test reports.  

### 4. Submission Instructions  
- Quotations must be submitted in PDF format to **procurement@pgcil.co.in** no later than **[Insert Submission Deadline – e.g., 15 September 2026]**.  
- The subject line of the email should read: *“Quotation – GEM/2026/B/TEST_BROKEN – Control Panels”*.  
- Please include the tender reference number on all correspondence.  

### 5. Evaluation Criteria  
Quotations will be evaluated on the basis of price, lead time, compliance with technical specifications, and GST treatment.  

### 6. Contact for Clarifications  
Should you require any clarification, please contact:  

- **Name:** [Your Name]  
- **Title:** Procurement & Supply Chain Specialist, Volks Energie (on behalf of PGCIL)  
- **Phone:** +91‑XXXXXXXXXX  
- **Email:** procurement@pgcil.co.in  

We look forward to receiving your competitive quotation and thank you for your interest in partnering with PGCIL on this critical project.

Yours sincerely,

[Your Full Name]  
Procurement & Supply Chain Specialist  
Volks Energie (acting for PGCIL)
